related.title: 蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「硫化氫與汞的減排」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Abating hydrogen sulphide and mercury" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦地熱發電的發源地一百二十年：蒸汽流量、管線凝結、減排、岩石蓄熱與地區供電；蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統則以世界最大的乾蒸汽田如何被抽乾又救回來：蒸汽耗率、壓力與產量、廢水回注與微震為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A hundred and twenty years at the birthplace of geothermal power: steam flow, pipeline condensate, abatement, heat in rock and regional supply; The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex centres on how the world's largest dry-steam field was drawn down and rescued: steam rate, pressure and output, wastewater injection and microseismicity, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱源溫度與效率上限」與「熱源溫度與效率上限」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「輸汽管線的凝結量」的模型移到蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「輸水管線的泵功」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" and "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling".
Move the model of "Condensate in a steam main" to The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Pumping power of the water pipeline", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「硫化氫與汞的減排」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Abating hydrogen sulphide and mercury" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex must be respecified.

related.title: 波夕市地熱區域供熱系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「硫化氫與汞的減排」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；波夕市地熱區域供熱系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Abating hydrogen sulphide and mercury" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Boise District Geothermal Heating System must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦地熱發電的發源地一百二十年：蒸汽流量、管線凝結、減排、岩石蓄熱與地區供電；波夕市地熱區域供熱系統則以不發電、直接用的地熱：流量與供熱、取代的天然氣、管線溫降、回水融雪與熱交換器為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A hundred and twenty years at the birthplace of geothermal power: steam flow, pipeline condensate, abatement, heat in rock and regional supply; Boise District Geothermal Heating System centres on geothermal used directly without generating: flow and heat, gas displaced, temperature drop, snowmelt on return water and heat exchangers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱源溫度與效率上限」與「熱源溫度與效率上限」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「輸汽管線的凝結量」的模型移到波夕市地熱區域供熱系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「產能遞減與補充井」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" and "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling".
Move the model of "Condensate in a steam main" to Boise District Geothermal Heating System, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Production decline and make-up wells", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「硫化氫與汞的減排」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；波夕市地熱區域供熱系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Abating hydrogen sulphide and mercury" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Boise District Geothermal Heating System must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 拉德瑞洛地熱場現代化
history.text: 1818 年開始以地熱蒸汽提煉硼酸；1904 年首次以地熱發電；1913 年第一座商用地熱電廠啟用；1944 年電廠在戰爭中被毀；2017 年深井鑽達 500 °C 以上的地層。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1818: Extraction of boric acid with geothermal steam began. 1904: Electricity was first generated from geothermal steam. 1913: The first commercial geothermal plant opened. 1944: The plants were destroyed in the war. 2017: A deep well reached rock above 500 °C. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
